user.title: Hue Web
user.description: Address of the hue-web service (it owns the connections to the bridges). Home Assistant must be allowed to reach port 8000 there.

error.invalid_url: The address must start with http:// or https://.

abort.already_configured: This hue-web address is already configured.

create_hub_scene.name: Create JI-hub scene
create_hub_scene.description: Save the current lights of one or more rooms or zones (both bridges too) as a scene kept by hue-web; it uses no bridge memory.

areas.name: Areas
areas.description: Rooms or zones: Hue name, bridge:name, rid, or a Hue light entity of a room.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Plan the bridge calls and send nothing; the response lists them.

snapshot_scene.name: Save scene in the bridge
snapshot_scene.description: Save the current lights of a room or zone as a new scene in the bridge memory.

area.name: Area
area.description: Room or zone: Hue name, bridge:name, rid, or a Hue room light entity.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Plan the bridge calls and send nothing; the response lists them.

copy_scene.name: Copy scene
copy_scene.description: Copy a bridge scene to another room or zone of the same bridge.

scene.name: Scene
scene.description: Scene name (name@area when several areas have it), rid, or a Hue scene entity.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the copy (default: the same).

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Plan the bridge calls and send nothing; the response lists them.

set_effect.name: Set effect
set_effect.description: Start a light effect on a light, room or zone. breathe, wave and random are run by hue-web for a number of minutes; no_effect stops both kinds.

target.name: Target
target.description: Light, room or zone: Hue name, bridge:name, rid, or a Hue light entity.

effect.name: Effect
effect.description: Bridge effect (candle, fire, ...) or a hue-web effect (breathe, wave, random).

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long a hue-web effect runs (default 10).

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Plan the bridge calls and send nothing; the response lists them.

timed_effect.name: Sunrise or sunset
timed_effect.description: Let a light, room or zone brighten (sunrise) or dim (sunset) over a number of minutes; no_effect stops it.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Plan the bridge calls and send nothing; the response lists them.
